title: Make Build Script Budgets Opt In
description: Extend the existing test-budget wall-clock timeout system in repo/lib/js/index.ts (runTestBudgeted, runCargoTestBudgeted) so that EVERY spawned command in the script.ts infrastructure has a hard wall-clock budget and gets SIGKILLed on timeout — not just cargo test/vitest/go test. Root cause: cargo check/build/clippy can hang 90+ minutes on the shared target/ dir lock when multiple sessions run concurrently, and today those calls go through unbudgeted runCmd (execFileSync, no timeout) or raw spawnSync, hanging agents forever. Add a default 10-minute Cmd budget to runCmd itself (via spawnSync timeout+killSignal), reuse the existing 20-minute Build budget for cargo build/clippy/check/wasm builds, keep the Test budget unchanged, and exempt dev servers/interactive apps/nx orchestrators explicitly. Rename the ⏱️TestBudget region to ⏱️Budget. Migrate call sites in repo/lib/js/index.ts, root script.ts, ui/tui/rs/script.ts, framework/renderer/wgpu/script.ts, framework/product/os/dev/script.ts, framework/core/script.ts. Add nx.json cache input for SEMIO_BUILD_BUDGET_MS on test targets. Extend repo/lib/js/index.test.ts with budget-kill tests.
summary: Made build, generic command, Nx/script orchestration and daemon deadlines opt in by default (zero means unlimited), preserving positive explicit options/environment overrides. Fixed zero-budget handling in asynchronous build timers, captured-process bridge and exact Cargo compilation. Split coverage compilation from budgeted assertions. Added schema-first process vectors and runtime tests checked against existing Execa; registered the Nx regression target in both VS Code launch files. Validation: 12 new process tests, 26 exact Cargo tests and 16 existing command-budget tests passed (54 total); targeted diff whitespace check passed. Broader nextest-filter check is blocked by an existing missing schema filename; repo-lib lint has unrelated existing TypeScript errors. No full WASM rebuild was run. Full evidence and limitations are recorded in the ticket verification markdown; generated logs were removed.
